Radio Cairo FAQ

What frequency is Radio Cairo on?
In the A-26 season Radio Cairo is scheduled on 8 shortwave frequencies, including 9410, 9470, 9830, 9850, 9870, 9885 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 9830 kHz (6:15 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern). For Europe: 9890 kHz (10:15 pm – 11:15 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear Radio Cairo in the USA?
It isn't beamed at North America this season, so hearing it in the USA is a DX catch. Your best chance is 9830 kHz (6:15 pm – 7:30 pm Eastern) when that band is open, or listen through an online receiver (KiwiSDR/WebSDR) closer to its target area.

Does Radio Cairo broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 9890 kHz at 21:15–22:15 UTC to W. Europe.

Is Radio Cairo on the air right now?
As of Saturday, September 26, 2026, 09:51 UTC, Radio Cairo is not currently scheduled to be broadcasting. Next scheduled transmission is 9870 kHz at 15:00 UTC. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
